description: Komodo Kotlin/JVM debugging over stdio. Uses the launcher and project settings from lsp.elide-komodo. Do not set tcp_connection: attach port identifies the target JVM's JDWP agent, not the adapter.

sourceRoots.description: Additional source directories for JVM source paths, besides the module source roots in the Komodo project manifest.

request.description: Start a JVM directly under Komodo's debugger. Compile the classes before launching.

mainClass.description: Fully qualified main class; a top-level Kotlin main in File.kt is typically pkg.FileKt.

classPaths.description: Compiled class directories and dependency jars for the program.

vmArgs.description: JVM options for the debuggee, not the Komodo adapter.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the program, not the Komodo adapter.

javaHome.description: JDK for the program; defaults to the JDK used by the debugger.

request.description: Start Komodo over stdio and attach it to a running JVM's JDWP agent. PID attach is unsupported.

hostName.description: Host of the target JVM's JDWP agent.

port.description: Target JVM JDWP port, not an adapter transport port.

timeout.description: Milliseconds to keep retrying the JDWP connection.
